A little help. A lot of heart.

Built with the shared tablet in mind.

The primary target is Amazon Fire tablets. Compatibility still needs testing on physical devices before release.

01

A comfortable shared screen

The design targets 7–10-inch screens in portrait and landscape with touch targets at least 48dp.

02

No mandatory Google Play Services

The product architecture is intended to work without Google account registration or required Play Services.

03

Android distribution

Amazon ended its Appstore for Android mobile devices on 20 August 2025; Fire tablet support continues. Secondary Android distribution needs a separate path.
